import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_29/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_29/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join on 'city'
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="city", how="inner")

# Group by city and type, aggregations:
# sum of driver_count from df0
# average of fare from df1
# count of ride_id from df1
agg_df = df_joined.groupby(["city", "type"]).agg(
    driver_count=pd.NamedAgg(column="driver_count", aggfunc="sum"),
    Average_Fare=pd.NamedAgg(column="fare", aggfunc="mean"),
    Ride_Count=pd.NamedAgg(column="ride_id", aggfunc="count"),
).reset_index()

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly
agg_df.rename(columns={"Average_Fare": "Average Fare", "Ride_Count": "Ride Count"}, inplace=True)

# Ensure correct dtypes
agg_df["city"] = agg_df["city"].astype(str)
agg_df["type"] = agg_df["type"].astype(str)
agg_df["driver_count"] = agg_df["driver_count"].astype(int)
agg_df["Average Fare"] = agg_df["Average Fare"].astype(float)
agg_df["Ride Count"] = agg_df["Ride Count"].astype(int)

# Save to target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_29/target_multisource.csv"
agg_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_29/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_29/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city (inner join to keep only matching cities)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city", how="inner")

# Group by city, driver_count, type (leftmost non-float columns in target schema)
# Aggregations: average fare, count of ride_id
result = joined.groupby(
    ["city", "driver_count", "type"], as_index=False
).agg(
    {
        "fare": "mean",
        "ride_id": "count"
    }
)

# Rename columns to match target schema
result.rename(columns={"fare": "Average Fare", "ride_id": "Ride Count"}, inplace=True)

# Write output to target file
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_29/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
